name: Erorie Nyuunyuu
original_name: エロリィ・ニューニュー
source:
Blood type: ERO type
Likes: thick things, sturdy things, rod-shaped things, bananas
Skills: squishy-squishy and other abilities involving the use of breasts
Role: NPC that guides heroes towards victory

A female NPC boasting massive 120 cm I-cup breasts whose character setting was created by [url=/c62009]Owari Sekai[/url] and who was designed by [url=/c62608]Yuuki Natsumi[/url]. She appears in Judgement 7's third game "Synchro Dive", but doesn't get much on-screen time due her clashing with the overall style of the game. She flirts with the the male members and with those involved in her creation, but is utterly harsh on [url=/c62607]Asano[/url] who has small breasts.
